risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate and serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/generic industrial machine, not a premium 'Brother' unit

risks.risk: Motor and electrical function unknown — could be seized, noisy, or non-functional
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine powered on and stitching a test seam

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (bobbins, extra needles, oil, manual) despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Photo of all claimed accessories laid out together with the machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare machine head only, no accessories

risks.risk: Wiring, plug, and pedal/clutch condition unknown — possible safety or repair cost
risks.proof: Close-up photo of plug, cable, and pedal/clutch assembly

risks.risk: Table/stand sturdiness and whether it is included in the sale is unclear
risks.proof: Photo showing the full table/stand and seller confirmation it's included
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine head only, table/stand excluded

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history despite 'never serviced' claim
risks.proof: Photo of maintenance log, purchase receipt, or visible wear on moving parts
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, unknown-age unit

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the nameplate/serial number
Video of the machine powered on, running, and stitching a sample
Photo of all included accessories, bobbins, needles, oil, and manual laid out together
Close-up of the plug, wiring, and pedal/clutch assembly
Full photo of the table/stand confirming inclusion and condition
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an industrial sewing machine, but the seller's brand claim conflicts with the visible nameplate text and none of the functional or completeness claims are shown, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
